# E0621: an example's example.cue is not valid

Each lineage a playground deployment offers as an example has an example.cue
beside its version files, describing it: a category, the group it is listed
in, and optionally a title and a summary, each a string. Nothing else may be
in it.

## Example

`lineages/cat/history/0.0.thema`:

```cue
Schema: {
	lives: int
}
```

`lineages/cat/tip.thema`:

```cue
Schema: {
	lives: int
}
```

`lineages/cat/example.cue`:

```cue
category: "Pets"
color:    "grey"
```

thema reports:

```
error[E0621]: lineages/cat/example.cue has a field color, which is not category, title or summary
 --> lineages/cat/example.cue:2:1
  |
2 | color:    "grey"
  | ^^^^^
  |
  = help: remove the field
```
